contact.name: Sal
contact.intro: Sal runs the lock-up behind the depot. Cash, no receipts, no questions. Marge would hate this.
contact.line_low: Keep it quiet and we're fine.
contact.line_high: You're warm, kid. Lie low a day.

branches.name: Fencing
branches.blurb: Goods go to Sal for more than the market pays. Nobody asks where they came from.

branches.name: Night moves
branches.blurb: Moves after dark for people who do not want a paper trail. Big pay, bigger heat.

branches.name: Knock-offs
branches.blurb: Make it on the bench, sell it as the real thing.

nodes.name: Small fence
nodes.blurb: Sell one trade good to Sal at 1.5x.

nodes.name: The good customer
nodes.blurb: Sal pays 2.4x for anything restored or mint.

nodes.name: After hours
nodes.blurb: Take a no-questions move at 1.6x pay. The route is dark.

nodes.name: The quiet route
nodes.blurb: Night moves pay 2.6x and the alley never costs heat.

nodes.name: Close enough
nodes.blurb: Sell a made thing as the branded one at 1.7x.

nodes.name: Provenance
nodes.blurb: Knock-offs sell at 3.0x and come with a story.

visits: A clipboard and a polite knock. Two trade goods confiscated and a fine.
Someone in a grey coat asks about the lock-up. You pay to make them bored.
Marge hears a rumour. She says nothing, which is worse. Rep slips.
